checkpoints.description: [1/3] Add floor omens, Skeletal Archer and Crypt Hound mobs, QoL shortcuts and reduced motion, and three story entries; extend harness and inspector proofs

impact_assessment.why: Every floor played the same, the only mid-depth enemy closed to melee, the header showed no floor mood, and the codex stopped at the pacts.
impact_assessment.benefits: Rule-changing deterministic floor moods, two new enemy behaviours and silhouettes, keyboard and motion accessibility, and a story thread that closes at the Crown.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive omen state and lore ids; dependency: none; concurrency: omen applies once per seed+depth; state: omen recomputed on resume, reduced motion persisted
impact_assessment.mitigation: Server/lore/unit tests, 28-check harness selftest, 63-check three-viewport audit with pixel proofs, gates

handoff.next: record the UI task and push
